Kissun Chiropractic® is a team of Australian trained & registered chiropractors, practicing in Singapore. We provide expert hands-on physical therapy and chiropractic care with an integrated approach to health and natural recovery, without the use of drugs or surgery, for all ages at affordable prices.

Conditions we treat:
    Back Pain, Slipped / Herniated Disc and Degenerative Disc
    Neck Pain and Whiplash
    Headaches and Migraines
    Spondylosis, Arthritis, Osteoarthritis
    Scoliosis
    Poor Posture
    Sciatica
    Numbness / Tingling
    Shoulder, Elbow, Wrist, Hip, Knee, Ankle and Foot Conditions
    Flat Feet / Pronation Syndrome
    Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) Disorder
    Pregnancy Aches and Pains
    Sports Injuries

Conveniently located in Raffles Place and Siglap.

Call +65 6243 2191 for an appointment
